assertion_results.text: Release dedup is skipped when its Upstream Affected Component configuration is absent. When trusted release evidence is available, the proposed procedure resolves originating CVEs through Blocks/Depend links, compares their components and allows library-summary fallback only for a missing Depend link or component field; a known nonmatch does not count as dedup, and unavailable release evidence is not fabricated.
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md 7.5.3: '**Decision: dedup is skipped. No existing coverage is assumed, and new remediation tasks are created.** The prerequisite is not met: the **Upstream Affected Component custom field is not configured**' and 'The library-summary fallback is only used inside the dedup procedure when the field exists but a linked CVE lacks it, so it is not used here. No stream is marked as dedup'd.' No release-Task CVE links or components are fabricated; checklist: 'Dedup consistency: no stream dedup'd (7.5.3 skipped)'.
